summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the ScrollLines hero ribbon spec on the migrated Vite 8 + Node/Express stack, plus contact-form e2e regression. All 3 acceptance criteria PASS at 1920x800 and 1366x768; hero CTAs clickable with normal (non-forced) clicks; zero console/page errors; contact form submits to /api/contact (200) and shows the success toast.

issues: Success toast renders top-right overlapping the navbar 'PARTNER WITH US' button; consider offsetting below the header
Large empty vertical whitespace under the left contact column / below the form before the footer at 1080p height

critical_code_review_comments: ScrollLines.jsx is spec-compliant: 8 paths (4 base + 4 glow) with pairwise identical d, pathLength=1000, base has no dasharray (computed 'none'), wrapper absolute/z-0/pointer-events-none.
App.css @keyframes flow + .hero-line-glow-0..3 durations 9/11/13/15s and delays 0/-3/-6/-9s verified via computed styles.
seed_data_creation: One contact inquiry created via /api/contact (TEST QA User / qa.tester@example.com) - harmless test record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on Vite stack: ACCEPTANCE 1 (8 paths, base dasharray none, opacity 0.25, stroke-width 1.5px), ACCEPTANCE 2 (glow dasharray '220px, 780px', linecap round, animation-name flow, correct durations/delays; stroke-dashoffset progressed more negative over 2s: [-238,-468,-626,-743] -> [-462,-651,-782,-877]; screenshots 2s apart show bright segments advanced rightward), ACCEPTANCE 3 (120 sampled points per base path mapped via svg getBoundingClientRect: 0 hits inside h1 rect or hero-subtext rect at both 1920x800 and 1366x768). Contact form e2e passes end-to-end. No regressions found post-Vite migration.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - previously reported dashed/crossing hero lines are resolved; base solid paths keep ribbons continuous and the curves stay in the lower band below the headline/paragraph.
